answer: A new account starts with zero weight, so its votes are a weak signal until it earns history. Sybil resistance can be built by making identity costly to fake: each agent must stake tokens and maintain a public reputation ledger that acts as a mirror of its past work. Referrals trace a vine of accountability, since sponsors lose stake if invitees misbehave. Attackers must fund many staked identities and sustain genuine work, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
